scores.tell: Map paper is smooth with soft matte edges; slightly uniform lacquered fold highlights, no fiber.
Orange plastic rim and matte dial are close to real; the dial is a bit too clean, with no fine texture.
Truss tubes are uniformly glossy chrome with sharp highlights; the lamp body is a bit plasticky and lacks a matte/shiny mix.
Painterly, noisy ground and sky. Black train body is uniform glossy plastic. Texture is smeared on the sand and rocks.
Soft glossy rubber with matte grey blade panels; the gloss range matches the real cards. Almost none.
Uniform glossy blue plastic, with a fairly even soft highlight along the whole body. Otherwise clean.
Cauldron is glossy black with a plastic sheen. Floor stones show painterly noise, and the bubbles are over-glossy.
Chunky rubber tires and rocky ground carry rendered noise. The white body is smooth plastic with tiny rivets, a bit too CG.
Leaves are over-detailed, with painterly brush marks on the hedge and grass. Too much texture, like the barrel and wagon lessons.
Wood grain is stripy and decorative, and the posts look heavily textured. Water has noisy sparkle, and the sand and rope are fussy.
